messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Vectorizing unary functions
parts:
Hi Daniel,

I have vectorized a function. If you look on the issue (https://github.com/stan-dev/math/issues/202) and on Bob's first comment, I've been checking off which functions I have vectorized. Rayleigh
